create_webhook_endpoint: create a FastAPI webhook endpoint that validates and processes HuggingFace dataset webhook payloads
parse_webhook_payload: parse and validate a HuggingFace moon-landing webhook v2 JSON payload against the defined schema
process_webhook_payload: process a validated webhook payload to add, update, move, or remove dataset repositories
validate_webhook_secret: validate the x-webhook-secret header to trust the sender of a webhook request
handle_webhook_remove_event: handle a webhook remove event to delete a dataset and its associated storage contents
